log.msg: Goal: comprehensive beginner-to-expert site covering every language, Python first.
Asked about PR policy and stack: the Advisor merges after validation; Astro + MDX on GitHub Pages.
PR 1 merged: roles, workflow, state.json, RESUME.md.
Dispatched M1 (scaffold) and M2/M3 (catalog, Python research) in parallel.
Stopped before writing: worktree was based on a stale commit, and reference sites were unreachable. Found Astro 7.3.8 on npm.
Blocked: python.org, Wikipedia, TIOBE and survey.stackoverflow.co are denied. Search summaries say Python 3.15.0 was released on 2026-10-09 (unverified).
Escalated the network access issue. The user is widening it.
Asked to reduce token cost and to split the loop into several workflows.
Revised into W1–W6 event-triggered workflows; added the Haiku summarizer and scripted validation.
PR 2 merged: six workflows and the progress board.
W3 run: scaffold plus validate.sh. Most reference design sites are now reachable.
Added the domains to network access.
W1 run: catalog from Wikipedia, Python 3.x facts, outline, fundamentals outline. www.python.org, TIOBE and SO survey still blocked; using search for those.
Scaffold done; validate.sh passes (73 links). Cream, brick-red and Fraunces palette.
Design gate FAIL: the cream, terracotta and serif look reads as AI-generated. Asked for a cool palette, a sans-serif display face and no-JS dark mode.
Revised: cobalt on cool white, Bricolage Grotesque; AA in both themes.
PR 4 opened; CI green; merged. First Pages deploy started.
Deploy succeeded: site live on GitHub Pages.
Python 3.15.0 (2026-10-09) confirmed on python.org and PEP 790. Catalog: 14/29/601 = 644 languages. Outline: 107 lessons; fundamentals: 28.
PRs 5 and 6 opened, CI green, merged.
Dispatched in parallel: Python B1, fundamentals module 1, catalog batch 1 (Haiku). Python 3.15.0 installed for running examples.
Fundamentals module 1 done (6 lessons, Python/JS/Java/C tabs).
PR 8 merged (fundamentals module 1).
B1 FAIL: Windows tab teaches the full installer, which has been deprecated since 3.14; the Python install manager is now recommended.
Blocked: curl to docs.python.org denied by the permission check.
Escalated: how should agents fetch the Python docs? The user allowed curl.
Catalog pages for all 644 languages; 40 tier-3 summaries (6 null).
B1 fixed: the Windows section now leads with the install manager; source cached.
PRs 9, 10, 11 merged. CI moved to uv for Python 3.15 (setup-python manifest lags).
Round 2 dispatched: Python B2, fundamentals module 2, catalog batch 2.
PRs 13 (B2) and 14 (fundamentals module 2) merged.
B3 PASS. '~True' deprecated in 3.12, removal in 3.16, confirmed against the docs.
Session rate limit hit. Fundamentals module 3 and batch 2 stopped before committing.
Resumed: PR 15 (B3) opened and merged; fundamentals module 3 and batch 2 relaunched.
Reported a CI failure. Cause: GitHub's legacy Jekyll Pages build. The user switched the Pages source to GitHub Actions.
PRs 16 (fundamentals module 3) and 17 (batch 2) merged. Only the Astro deploy runs now.
Batch 3: Wikipedia rate-limited; only 3 of 40 verified. Held, not merged.
PR 18 (B4) merged: PEP 584, 814 and 798 claims verified. B5 dispatched.
PR 20 (B5) merged. Beginner level complete, so W4 audit triggered.
P0: no tracebacks lesson; try used before it's taught; no mini-project. Fixed 3 bad catalog links.
Verdict: restrained and accurate. P0: scraped catalog data, syntax used before it's taught, wall-of-code blocks.
Triage: 4 parallel fix tasks.
PRs 23–26 merged (lesson UX, catalog data/UX, Wikipedia links).
Usage limit hit; beginner-fix Writer stopped with 24 uncommitted files.
Limit reset; continue.
PR 27 merged: beginner fixes (0 ordering violations, 364 examples).
PR 28 merged: B6 'Putting it together'. Beginner level complete (37 lessons). I1 and fundamentals module 4 dispatched.
PRs 30–36 merged: fundamentals complete and language-neutral (28 lessons); Python intermediate I1–I4 (31 lessons). I5 in progress.

PRs 38–46 merged: I5, dates lesson, W4 intermediate audit and fixes, UI sidebar/output frames, lesson/version checks, intermediate project. Intermediate level complete (42 lessons). A1 typing in progress.
PRs 48–59 merged: Python advanced level complete (27 lessons) and audited; strict heading check; forward links. Expert E1/E2 in progress.
PRs 61-70 merged: Python expert E1-E3 (18 lessons), expert audit (gaps + review) and P0 fixes, JS research and validation, JavaScript B1-B2 (11 lessons), board scroll panels.
PRs 71-78 merged: Python expert audit fixes and capstone; Python track complete (beginner to expert). JavaScript beginner level written (40 lessons, B1-B7); C extensions now compiled in CI.

PRs 79-90 merged: JS beginner audit (gaps + review) and fixes (fundamentals-id check, language page, runtime-named badges, lessons 01-40 reworked); JavaScript intermediate level written (38 lessons, I1-I6).

Keep. Version accuracy is where mistakes cost most, and it runs only once per language.
Changed. Sonnet is enough for beginner and intermediate. Concurrency, memory models and metaprogramming need Opus.
Changed. The mechanical checks moved to scripts/validate.sh, which costs no tokens. Sonnet only fact-checks diffs.
Keep. Strong at front-end work, and it runs only in W3.
Keep. It now runs once per level instead of once per module.
Keep. It runs once per level and reviews a sample, not the whole site.
